q: What should we check ourselves before an external verifier looks at our emissions?
title: Internal review before verification
short: Run the checks a verifier would: totals match the invoices, units are right, factors are from the right year, every month is there and estimates are labelled. A one-day internal review usually finds the errors that would otherwise come back as findings and cost a second round.

ul: Twelve months of bills and invoices for every source.
Units: kWh not kVAh, litres not kg, SCM not MMBTU unless converted.
Emissions per tonne of output against last year.
Litres per unit for DG sets.
Fuel per tonne of steam for boilers.

p: Someone who did not prepare the figures, even a colleague from accounts.

senseible: Senseible keeps every figure linked to its source invoice or bill with a fingerprint, so a verifier can trace a total back to the documents it came from.
